subject: zombie
label: zombie, in the place of the game's models/zombie.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/barney.mdl, models/hassassin.mdl, models/scientist.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, A, C where the asset was B, D, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Every view has the hunched, shambling outline the brief asks for: the torso leans forward in the left, right and front-left views, the arms hang to the knees with claws, and a dome-topped head sits over the shoulders. The coat's blocky shoulders and the dark wedge at the hip (left and right views) are not enough to change the outline.

M2.reason: The brief gives a height of about 68. The asset is 68.2 tall (0.3% off), so it is within 15%. Width and depth are not set by the brief.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, checked down to the small ones: parasite body over the head (green head with a tan dome, front and top views); long clawed hands (both hands, three or more claws each, front and left views); torn lab coat with a ragged hem (front and front-left views); blood (red splashes on the chest, belly and left side); hunched back (left and right views); trousers and shoes reaching the floor. All present. The extra dark wedge is not a missing part, so it is charged to M1, not here.

M4.reason: The coat is white, the parasite and hands are sickly green, the dome is tan, the trousers and boots are dark, and the blood is dark red. Each region carries the colour a player would expect for a bloodied scientist zombie.

M5.reason: The coat carries a dense diagonal checker-stripe grain across the front, back and sleeves, which reads more as noise than fabric or wear. The blood patches are clear and placed on the chest, sides and back, but the coat's torn edges are not drawn as torn fabric.

M6.reason: Set by the line-up test, not this judging: the judges picked the asset in none of three runs (D, A, C where it was B, D, D), so it passes for one of the game's. Scored 2 as the rubric caps it here.

M7.reason: The front is the front: the green head and claws face the viewer in the front view. It stands upright on its feet, and in the walk frames both feet meet the floor line at the origin.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. The asset has 574 triangles, under twice the median of Half-Life's kind (504, so under 1008) and under the third quartile (731). The below view shows a dark cavity under the chest, but it is on the underside a player never sees; from every view a player does see, nothing is open, inside out or floating.

C1.reason: In the walk frames (0 to 23) the legs, arms, claws and the dark wedge move with the torso and stay on it, and nothing sinks or floats. In the attack frames (0 to 7) the arms come forward with the claws, and the hands and head stay on the body throughout. The slash is small, but no part comes apart.
